name: Aviat Networks, Inc.
summary: Aviat Networks, Inc. provides microwave networking and wireless access networking solutions in North America, Africa, the Middle East, Europe, Latin America, and the Asia Pacific. The company provides outdoor, indoor, and split-mount radios; microwave routers, and trunking; private LTE/5G, access and network management products; narrow band multi-point radios, designed, and optimised for SCADA and telemetry applications; and hosted software products, such as aviat design, frequency assurance, aviatcloud, and health assurance software.
